headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 31, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 18.85% compared to SPY's 9.97%. This results in an average alpha of 8.88%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A,' shows a significant return of 43.91%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 50,' still maintains a respectable return of 13.64%. This outperformance against SPY is particularly notable during periods of market uncertainty, providing a useful signal of resilience. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
